newsitem.title: FINLAND: FINNISH JULY CONSTRUCTION COSTS UP 2.6 PCT YR/YR.
newsitem.headline: FINNISH JULY CONSTRUCTION COSTS UP 2.6 PCT YR/YR.

text.p: Construction costs rose 2.6 percent year-on-year in July and 0.3 percent on June, Statistics Finland (SF) said in a statement on Thursday.
The 1995-base construction cost index was 101.7 points in July.
In June, the year-on-year rise in the construction cost index was 2.5 percent and the increase on May was 0.3 percent.
"The rise in construction costs is accelerating," SF said. "Growth from January to July was almost two percent, when in the previous half year it was 0.8 percent," it said.
